goal: Allow wallet users to send transactions to BIP 352 silent payment addresses
Provide privacy-preserving sends with dynamic recipient output derivation
reviewability: Ready for review as nothing known invalidates it
agreement: Verified output derivation compatibility across 315 transactions with an external tool (fametrano)
Verified key filtering and fee bumping edge cases through targeted testing (Yudis-bit)
Suggested avoiding special coin selection logic to prevent on-chain fingerprinting (davidgumberg)
Suggests moving the test scanner to a separate PR or introducing a scanning RPC (rustaceanrob)
Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, polespinasa)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it adds a major user privacy feature by allowing transactions to silent payment addresses
It unblocks subsequent roadmap milestones for BIP 352 silent payments support
